title: Business HR
description: Job Title: Business HRLocation: Tada, Andhra PradeshDepartment: Human ResourcesRole PurposeTo act as a strategic HR Business Partner for the factory operations, ensuring effective implementation of HR practices, employee engagement, statutory compliance, and smooth workforce management to support business objectives.Key Responsibilities1. HR Business PartneringPartner with plant leadership to align HR strategies with business goalsDrive workforce planning, manpower budgeting, and productivity initiativesSupport business in organizational development and change management2. Talent Acquisition & OnboardingManage end-to-end recruitment for factory roles (blue collar & white collar)Ensure timely onboarding and smooth induction for new employeesCoordinate with consultants and vendors for hiring needs3. Employee Engagement & RelationsBuild a positive employee relations climate within the factoryHandle employee grievances, disciplinary actions, and conflict resolutionDrive engagement initiatives, communication forums, and welfare activities4. Performance ManagementFacilitate KRA/KPI goal setting, reviews, and performance discussionsSupport managers in performance improvement plans (PIP)Ensure timely closure of appraisal cycles5. Statutory Compliance & Industrial RelationsEnsure compliance with all applicable labor laws and statutory requirementsLiaise with government authorities and manage audits/inspectionsMaintain records related to compliance (Factories Act, PF, ESI, etc.)6. HR OperationsMaintain employee records, attendance, leave, and payroll inputsEnsure accuracy in HRMS data and documentationSupport audits and reporting requirements7. Learning & DevelopmentIdentify training needs and coordinate L&D initiatives for factory employeesDrive skill development programs for workforce capability building8. Factory Training & Capability BuildingPlan and execute mandatory factory trainings (Safety, POSH, GMP, SOPs, Compliance)Coordinate with internal/external trainers for shop-floor training programsEnsure training coverage for all employees including contract workforceMaintain training records, attendance, and audit-ready documentationEvaluate training effectiveness and drive continuous improvement initiativesKey RequirementsEducation: MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalentExperience: 5–8 years of HR experience, preferably in manufacturing / factory setupStrong knowledge of labor laws and statutory complianceExperience in handling industrial relations and shop-floor workforceGood communication and stakeholder management skillsKey CompetenciesBusiness AcumenEmployee Relations & Conflict ManagementCompliance OrientationExecution ExcellenceStakeholder ManagementPreferred SkillsExposure to HRMS systemsProficiency in Telugu Language is must.Experience in FMCG / Manufacturing industryAbility to work in a fast-paced factory environmentSuccess MetricsTimely closure of hiring requirementsCompliance adherence with zero non-conformitiesEmployee engagement and retention levelsEffective grievance handling and IR climateOn-time performance management cycle completion
